title: NERDC eCurriculum portal and LMIS SSS 1–3 curriculum portals
subject: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry
limitations: eCurriculum portal (nerdc.org.ng/eCurriculum) returns HTTP 500. SSS 3 portals (sss_3, s3_core, s3_science) return HTTP 404 — SSS 3 curriculum documents not retrievable via this portal. SSS 1 and SSS 2 viewers for Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics retrieved successfully as PDFs.
notes: Portal structure: viewer/sss_{1,2}/{id} iframes load .../necurrdc/viewer.html?file={id}.pdf; Mathematics=2, Chemistry=7, Physics=8 (per observed subject listings).
